//: Zeus tower - a 150-tile stone tower on an open plain (Stages 'hill'). Replaces the earlier cone-shaped hill; the stage id and file names are kept as the encounter's proper noun so nothing downstream has to be renamed. Geometry: a 7-wide shaft from world tile y -137 (the summit deck the statue stands on) down to the ground plane at y 13, with 39-wide decks every 15 tiles and a switchback stair - one tile of rise per column, alternating sides - linking each deck to the next. Every deck, and the ground, has a 3-row doorway punched through the shaft: without those the shaft splits each deck into two balconies that never connect and the climb dead-ends at level 1. AUTHORED BY GENERATOR: run scripts/gen-tower.py to rebuild every hill_*.txt from the geometry constants; do not hand-edit them. Rules cover only what a list of axis-aligned half-planes can say - the ground plane, the two outer walls that stop a knockback launch leaving the world, and open sky above the summit. The decks, stairs and doorways repeat every 15 tiles, which the rule grammar has no modulo for, hence the generator. Extents 9 because the tower spans chunk rows -9..0. Enemy and flock placement lives in Stage.cs.
